6. Players can play solo, duo, or trio. 
7. The maximum length of a game is 4 holes. 
8. Players can move the net to extend the course if no player has an advantage. 
9. The winner is the player with the lower score after 4 rounds. 
10. If there are ties at the end of the four rounds, the player who won the last round is the winner. 
11. Golf is a team sport, so if one player is in a disadvantage, the team’s advantage could be lost. 
12. If the player has no disc, they can use a metal ping-pong ball. 
13. At the 36th pole, a double bogey is scored and the player takes a five stroke penalty.
